tagline: Geopolitics in the spirit of HOI4: towns, nations, trade and wars with rules. Vanilla+, no mods required. The world grows every day, and every week unlocks something new.

weeks.title: Landfall
weeks.text: Everyone starts at the old stone tower at 0, 0. Pioneer chests are hidden around it. The first town with 3+ residents earns the title «First Settlers» and a reward.

weeks.title: Trade Routes
weeks.text: Ports open. Take cargo at a port and deliver it to the capital for diamonds. The whole server knows when a caravan sets out, and the cargo can be stolen. Helpers unlock on day 7.

weeks.title: Fight for Resources
weeks.text: Neutral points: a mine, a forge, a lighthouse. Hold a point for 3 minutes with no rivals and it is yours. Every 10 minutes the residents of the owning town get income.

weeks.title: Age of Nations and the Great War
weeks.text: Nations open. Two days of formation, then mobilisation, then the Great War: battles from 17:00 to 22:00 Moscow time while two or more defenders are online. Results and rewards come at the end of the week.

weeks.title: Seasons
weeks.text: Every real week is a new season: spring, summer, autumn, winter. Supply drops in the wilderness, harvest into the treasury in autumn, cold on foreign land in winter.

weeks.title: Open World
weeks.text: The border reaches 2000 blocks. Build empires, sign pacts, take vassals.

mechanics.title: Personal claims
mechanics.summary: Shift + place a claim block, and the plot is protected for the full height of the world.
points: Copper block: 11×11, iron: 21×21, gold: 31×31, diamond: 51×51.
Up to 3 claims per player, no closer than 80 blocks to spawn.
Protected: blocks, chests, doors, buckets, animals, fire, explosions, pistons and water from outside, pressure plates, hoppers.
During a battle between nations at war, claims can be raided, but the claim block itself cannot be broken.
Break your own claim block and the claim is removed.

mechanics.title: Towns and nations
mechanics.summary: Towny: your own town, taxes, a treasury, nations made of several towns.
points: Town: 500$, nation: 3000$ (nations open in week 4).
Chunk: from 50$ (2% more each, up to 300$), outpost: 750$.
Daily upkeep: town 25$, nation 150$. Without money the town goes into debt and is not deleted.
There is no /home or /tpa: travel with /t spawn and vehicles.

mechanics.title: Economy
mechanics.summary: Start with 200$, sell your loot, send money, climb the rich list.
points: 1 diamond = 100$. You can sell ores, ingots, crops, logs and mob loot. Stone does not sell.
Town and nation taxes are set by the mayor and the leader.
Helper upgrades cost from 500$ to 1,000,000$.

mechanics.title: The Great War
mechanics.summary: Wars with rules: declared 24 hours ahead, battles only in prime time.
points: Declare in Discord 24 hours ahead, with a casus belli. An admin adds the war to the game.
Battles from 17:00 to 22:00 Moscow time, and only if at least 2 defenders are online.
During a battle, PvP and explosions are enabled in the towns of the nations at war.
Points for killing enemies, diamonds for the winners.
Anti-ruin: walls can be breached, but everything is restored after 30 minutes.

mechanics.title: Diplomacy
mechanics.summary: Non-aggression pacts, vassals and tribute, white peace, allies in wars.
points: Non-aggression pact: up to 30 days, 100$ from each nation's treasury. Breaking it takes 24 hours.
A vassal pays its overlord 10% of its treasury a day (up to 500$) and can start a war of independence.
Towny allies get an invitation to join a war, vassals join automatically.
All actions are taken by the nation leader.

mechanics.title: National focuses
mechanics.summary: Like in HOI4: the leader picks a focus, pays from the treasury, and a few hours later the nation gets a bonus.
points: Industry: +16 chunks, Haste at home, +150$ a day.
Army: gear for everyone, Resistance at home in battle, Speed and Strength in battle.
Economy: +100$ a day, free pacts, double tribute from vassals.
Total War and Hegemony exclude each other.
Details: «Focus guide» (order, builds, timing before the war).

mechanics.title: Heritage of the powers
mechanics.summary: The nation leader takes the heritage of one of the 10 powers from the lore: a permanent bonus and a unique 10th focus. Each heritage goes to one nation only.
points: Romea: pacts for 50$. SPQR focus: +1 war point for each enemy killed on your land.
Carthage: +25$ a day. Guns of Gaius: siege weapons 25% cheaper.
Hellas: Water Breathing. Sea League: Dolphin's Grace as well.
Dacia: Haste I below Y=40. Copper of Caer-Tal: Haste II at home.
Germania: Speed I at home. Iron and Coal: +100$ a day.
Gallia: autumn harvest pays 60$. Sacred Groves: Regeneration I at home in battle.
Horde: Speed I in the wilderness. Out of the Sandstorm: Strength I on foreign land in battle.
Scythia: +20$ a day per town. Royal Kurgans: vassal tribute 15%.
Northern Kingdom: no winter cold. Blizzard of 1942: in winter, enemies on your land get Slowness II.
Island Union: pays half the tribute as a vassal. Republic of Seafarers: Dolphin's Grace and Water Breathing.
Heritage focus: 1500$, 24 hours, needs any tier 1 focus.

mechanics.title: Race and people
mechanics.summary: Every player chooses a race (15 races: five Forerunner bloodlines and ten fantasy peoples) and a people (one of the 10 powers of the lore). A race has a strength, a weakness and three personal focuses; a people has its own «Heir» focus.
points: The first choice is free. Changing costs 1000$, at most once every 7 days, and resets the related personal focuses.
Children of Clay (Ur-Kadim): +10$ a day. Focuses: another +15$ a day, Resistance I on your nation's land, Regeneration I in your own town.
Sunborn (Neferu): Fire Resistance in the Nether, but Weakness I on the surface at night. Focuses: Speed in deserts, Speed I by day under open sky, then Strength I.
Children of the Wave (Thalassia): Water Breathing, but Weakness I in deserts and the Nether. Focuses: Dolphin's Grace, Night Vision and Strength I in water.
Copper Blood (Caer-Tal): Haste I below Y=0 and above Y=100, but Mining Fatigue I in water. Focuses: Resistance and Haste II below Y=0, +2 hearts.
The Silent (Deep Folk): Night Vision below Y=0, but Weakness I by day under open sky. Focuses: Speed and Resistance below Y=0, nearby enemies glow.

10 more races: elves (strength in forests), dwarves (toughness underground), orcs (fury in battle), halflings (luck and income), ashborn (strength in the Nether), dragon blood (fire and height), goblins (night and money), trolls (regeneration at night), fae (jumping and gliding), revenants (night and +2 hearts). Full table in the focus guide.
Personal focuses: p1 300$ and 6 h, p2 600$ and 12 h, p3 1200$ and 24 h, the people's «Heir» 1000$ and 24 h (needs p1). Paid from your own balance; time runs while you are offline too.
Kinsfolk: if your people matches your nation's heritage, +10$ a day.

mechanics.title: Siege weapons
mechanics.summary: A mortar, a siege cannon and a demolition charge, bought with money.
points: Mortar: 1500$, cannon: 4000$, demolition charge: 250$.
They break blocks only in the wilderness and in the towns of nations at war during a battle.
Chests, shulkers and spawners do not break, blocks do not drop, and everything is restored after 30 minutes.

mechanics.title: Arcanum: weapons of the Monolith
mechanics.summary: Our own magic weapons with particle animations: a staff that opens the Heavenly Gates, a blade with a dash, a vortex portal. A kill streak earns a scout drone and an airstrike.
points: Craft at a Star Altar: stand next to a lodestone and type /arcana craft <id>. You need Star Shards and Nameless Wreckage from cataclysms.

Staff of Oira (8 shards, a nether star, 4 gold blocks, a blaze rod): right-click fires the Guardian's Beam, Shift + right-click opens the Heavenly Gates: runes in the sky and 14 beams of light over an area.
Blade of the Sixth Line (2 netherite ingots, 4 shards, 2 echo shards, 8 diamonds): each hit has a 25% chance to flare with a rune, right-click dashes through enemies.
Vortex of the Nameless (a heart of the sea, 4 wreckage, 2 eyes of ender, 4 shards): a funnel portal pulls everyone in for 3 seconds, then collapses.
Kill streak without dying: 3 gives a Scout Drone (enemy players glow for 15 seconds), 5 gives a Target Designator: an airstrike of 8 explosions 4 seconds after you mark the spot.
Blocks are never broken. Damage is dealt in the player's name, so newcomer protection, claims and peaceful towns work as usual.

mechanics.title: Seasons
mechanics.summary: After the Great War, every week is a new season with its own rules.
points: Spring «Sowing»: crops grow faster, drops with seeds.
Summer «Expeditions»: drops every 90 minutes, and richer.
Autumn «Harvest»: 64 crops → 40$ into the town treasury.
Winter «Winter Campaign»: Slowness on foreign land, crops grow slower.
Supply drop with 3+ players online: a chest in the wilderness for 30 minutes.

mechanics.title: Cataclysms and space
mechanics.summary: 18 events: thunderstorm, blizzard, drought, earthquake, star shower, the Fog of the Nameless… and the weather of the Moon and Mars.
points: They happen on their own every 45–90 minutes, announced 10 seconds ahead and in Discord.
Blocks are not broken. Damage only hits players with 5+ hearts. Newcomers and the tower at 0, 0 are protected.
Meteors and comets drop Star Shards, the fog leaves Nameless Wreckage.

mechanics.title: Helpers
mechanics.summary: From day 7, everyone can claim one helper, once.
points: The miner digs stone from a generator, the collector picks up items.
Everything goes into a linked chest. Upgrades cost money.

mechanics.title: Caravans and points
mechanics.summary: Events of the first weeks: cargo from a port to the capital, and capturing resource points.
points: The cargo drops on death and anyone can deliver it, so bring guards.
A point is captured by holding it for 3 minutes with no rivals.
Diamond rewards add up and are collected with one command.

mechanics.title: Comforts
mechanics.summary: Voice chat, skins, sitting and lying down, pictures in frames, vehicles.
points: Plasmo Voice: proximity voice chat.
SkinsRestorer, GSit, ImageFrame, HeadDB, armour stands.
MTVehicles cars and a territory map on BlueMap.

rules.title: Fair play
items: Cheats (X-Ray, autoclickers, flight), dupes and bug abuse are banned: ban and rollback.
Allowed: Sodium/OptiFine, a minimap without a player radar, Litematica without the printer, Plasmo Voice.
Chat without insults, spam or real-world politics.

rules.title: Griefing and peacetime
items: Griefing and killing without a reason are banned (everything is logged): ban.
Newcomers cannot be touched for their first 48 hours, and they cannot attack either.
Claims and towns are protected in peacetime. There is no /home or /tpa.

rules.title: Wars and diplomacy
items: Declare 24 hours ahead in Discord, with a casus belli.
Battles from 17:00 to 22:00 Moscow time, at least 2 defenders online. Night raids are banned.
Anti-ruin: you may breach walls and take loot, but you may not raze a town to the ground. Everything is restored after 30 minutes.
Pacts, vassals, white peace: /dip. A pact must be broken first.

rules.title: Events
items: At events, supply drops and caravans, PvP is free, with no declaration of war. Leave newcomers alone.

rules.title: Everything else is allowed
items: Intrigue, cunning negotiations and deals. What is not forbidden is allowed.

join: You need a licensed or any Java edition of Minecraft 26.2. Mods are optional.
Add the server at the address below and join. You start at the tower at 0, 0.
Optional: the PaxVanila client pack (Fabric) with shaders, a minimap without radar and optimisation. Import the .mrpack file in Modrinth App or Prism Launcher.
For voice chat, install the Plasmo Voice mod (it is in the pack).

places.name: The Monolith
places.text: The tower at the centre of the world and the spawn. Beneath it lie the great gates and the Copper Seal. No claims within 80 blocks.

powers.name: Romea
powers.text: Keepers of the seal, right by the Monolith. Heritage: pacts for $50, the SPQR focus.

powers.name: Carthage
powers.text: A trading power on the southern coast. Heritage: +$25 a day, cheaper siege engines.

powers.name: Hellas
powers.text: A maritime league of the south-western isles. Heritage: water breathing.

powers.name: Gaul
powers.text: Forests and sacred groves of the west. Heritage: autumn harvest, regeneration at home.

powers.name: The Island Union
powers.text: A republic of seafarers in the north-western ocean. Heritage: half tribute as a vassal.

powers.name: Germany
powers.text: Iron and coal of the north. Heritage: speed at home, +$100 a day with its focus.

powers.name: The Northern Tsardom
powers.text: The snows of the far north. Heritage: no winter cold, the Blizzard of 1942.

powers.name: Dacia
powers.text: Mountains and copper mines of the east, once Caer-Brun. Heritage: haste in the mines.

powers.name: The Horde
powers.text: The great steppe of the south-east. Heritage: speed in the wilds.

powers.name: Scythia
powers.text: The kurgans of the far east. Heritage: +$20 a day per town, 15% vassal tribute.

ancient.name: Ur-Kadim
ancient.text: Clay cities between two rivers, the first civilization. Neo-Kadim will later rise here.

ancient.name: Neferu
ancient.text: The Kingdom of the Sun in the sands south of the two rivers. The pyramids of the sun-bearers.

ancient.name: Thalassia
ancient.text: The hundred isles of the Western Sea, now sunk beneath the waves. The palace of Knossarion.

ancient.name: Caer-Tal
ancient.text: The seven «Green Cities» of the Copper Union in the mountains. Trial chambers and golem forges.

ancient.name: The Ancient City
ancient.text: Deep underground: the Silent, the sculk and the Warden.

lore.name: Romulus' Hill
lore.text: 753 BC: lightning strikes the hill where Romulus founds Romea.

lore.name: Harbours of Thalassia
lore.text: 2354 BC: the Great Storm takes the harbours.

lore.name: The dried rivers
lore.text: 1835 BC: drought, the sands of Neferu drink the rivers dry.

lore.name: Fall of the Carthaginian fleet
lore.text: 264 BC: a storm sinks the fleet of Carthage.

lore.name: The collapsed mines
lore.text: Year 117: an earthquake brings down the mines of Dacia.

lore.name: The coming of the Horde
lore.text: Year 375: the Steppe Horde rides out of a sandstorm.

lore.name: Walls of Romea, 1241
lore.text: A blizzard stops the Horde at the walls of Romea.

lore.name: The first Star Shard
lore.text: Year 1500: a meteor shower, the first shard is found.

lore.name: Fog of the Nameless
lore.text: Year 1700: galleons vanish in the fog.

lore.name: Trenches of the Age of Steel
Winter of 1942
lore.text: A blizzard breaks the Reich's offensive.

lore.name: The Village
lore.text: Record 1: «War for the Village». Score 0 : 3, operation «One More Time».

lore.name: The Gulag
lore.text: Record 2: the first camp of the Far Sector. Prisoner Telorfind.

lore.name: Object «Metro»
lore.text: 23.01.2021: an icy tunnel under the whole sector. The entrance is lost.

lore.name: The missing gunpowder
lore.text: The store is empty. «Where is the gunpowder? Season 2».

lore.name: The Sky Islands
lore.text: Record 3: three armies on islands in the sky. «Yellow: 0 left».

far.name: The Far Sector «Village»
far.text: About 5000 blocks from 0, 0, far beyond the widest world border. This is where the «Front Chronicle» happened: the War for the Village, Gulag and Gunpowder, War and Peace. The PAX oath does not reach here and there are no rules of war. The war laws of PaxVanila grew out of these three wars.
